correctness.rationale: On the smooth open U, direct differentiation proves that exactly the displayed hyperplanes and discriminant are excluded. Coefficient extraction from F squared in characteristic 3 yields diagonal Hasse--Witt entries 2(s+rt), 2(t+rs), 2(r+st); positive semilinear iterates preserve their nonzero support, establishing p-rank and a-number. The three zero surfaces are explicit graphs; pairwise axes and independent differentials on U prove simple normal crossings. The complete quadratic-character identity and inclusion--exclusion yield all four rank-count polynomials for every 3-power q; exact symbolic checking and fully independent exhaustive enumerations over F3, F9, F27 are corroborative, not infinite proofs.

value.rationale: The ordinary/nonordinary boundary of a natural genus-three curve family is a structurally motivated geometric object. This theorem identifies its entire reduced SNC incidence, characterizes ranks 0 through 3 geometrically, and counts every coefficient-marked stratum over every finite extension, rather than sampling small cases. It singles out the unique superspecial equation and transverse rank-drop axes, while identifying and respecting the prior general elliptic decomposition. Counts are not claimed to be moduli isomorphism counts.
